title: Sleepy monkey
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <defs>
    <linearGradient id='fur' x1='0' y1='0' x2='0' y2='1'>
      <stop offset='0' stop-color='#b5763a'/>
      <stop offset='1' stop-color='#8a5423'/>
    </linearGradient>
    <linearGradient id='face' x1='0' y1='0' x2='0' y2='1'>
      <stop offset='0' stop-color='#f6d7a3'/>
      <stop offset='1' stop-color='#e2b678'/>
    </linearGradient>
  </defs>
  <!-- ears -->
  <circle cx='20' cy='46' r='12' fill='url(#fur)'/>
  <circle cx='20' cy='46' r='6' fill='#f0c894'/>
  <circle cx='80' cy='46' r='12' fill='url(#fur)'/>
  <circle cx='80' cy='46' r='6' fill='#f0c894'/>
  <!-- head -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='48' rx='32' ry='30' fill='url(#fur)'/>
  <!-- face patch -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='56' rx='24' ry='20' fill='url(#face)'/>
  <!-- brow tufts -->
  <ellipse cx='40' cy='33' rx='9' ry='5' fill='#7a4a1e'/>
  <ellipse cx='60' cy='33' rx='9' ry='5' fill='#7a4a1e'/>
  <!-- sleepy closed eyes -->
  <path d='M32 48 q7 5 14 0' stroke='#4a2c14' stroke-width='3' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <path d='M54 48 q7 5 14 0' stroke='#4a2c14' stroke-width='3' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- muzzle -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='64' rx='14' ry='10' fill='#fbe8c4'/>
  <ellipse cx='45' cy='60' rx='2' ry='1.4' fill='#5a3a1c'/>
  <ellipse cx='55' cy='60' rx='2' ry='1.4' fill='#5a3a1c'/>
  <!-- mouth with zzz hint -->
  <path d='M44 68 q6 5 12 0' stroke='#7a4a1e' stroke-width='2.5' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- zzz -->
  <path d='M70 22 l6 0 l-6 6 l6 0' stroke='#9fe8ff' stroke-width='2.5' fill='none' stroke-linejoin='round' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <path d='M82 30 l4 0 l-4 4 l4 0' stroke='#9fe8ff' stroke-width='2' fill='none' stroke-linejoin='round' stroke-linecap='round'/>
</svg>
